title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-ergonomics-v1.183.0
author: Aditi Shah
description: Unify auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bump versions to v1.183.0. Motivation: we have subtle differences in token refresh behavior, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming chunk delivery semantics that create operational surprises for multi-language customers and downstream examples. This PR: 1) standardizes token refresh hook and credential caching semantics; 2) implements a shared retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter, idempotency-safe defaults, configurable max attempts) across SDKs; 3) harmonizes streaming APIs so partial transcripts and cancelation behave consistently (server-side close vs client cancel); 4) improves ergonomics: simplified streaming iterator in Python, better types and callbacks in TypeScript, and a more ergonomic context-based client in Go; 5) adds migration notes and bumps package versions to v1.183.0. This is intentionally split into small commits per SDK to ease review. No behavioral breaking changes for typical usage but some edge cases where custom retry spies may need minor adjustments. See commits and files changed for details.
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth/retries/streaming behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; ergonomics improvements; bump SDK versions to v1.183.0. See migration notes in docs/SDK-MIGRATION.md.
